name: Shiro Arc
source:
Arcueid is confined into a cellar together with Satsuki and Sion. First she just watches at how other girls are violated, then comes Arcueid's turn.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阿尔奎德与小月、赛恩一起被关在地窖里。首先她只是看着其他女孩如何被侵犯，然后轮到阿尔奎德了。
